- Only issued invoices can be credited (`invalid_state`).
- Uses `to_money`/`round_money` (rejects floats, banker's rounding per 2.0.0).
- Applies the updated FIN-2026-09 approval threshold of 1000.00 via keyword-only `approved_by`, raising `approval_required` above it.
- Supports keyword-only `idempotency_key`, checked first against the audit trail and returning the original result.
